title: Emptying a deactivated term with Move lets it be deleted
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop switched off a term of its own that one customer still uses, and wants to delete the term.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, is deactivated and held by one customer, {Customer-A}, and by no vendor or invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-24 Old and {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-24 Customer.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Inactive" tab.
  2. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  3. Click "Move Customers".
  4. Choose "Net 30" in "Move To".
  5. Click "Move 1 Customer".
  6. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  7. Click "Delete Credit Term".
  8. Click the red "Delete Credit Term" button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Term-A} is listed.
  • Step 2: the menu shows "Reactivate", "Move Customers" and a greyed "Delete Credit Term".
  • Step 3: the window "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens with {Customer-A} ticked.
  • Step 4: the dropdown shows Net 30.
  • Step 5: the toast "1 customer moved to Net 30." shows and {Term-A}'s Customers count reads 0.
  • Step 6: "Delete Credit Term" is now available (not greyed).
  • Step 7: the confirmation opens.
  • Step 8: the toast "{Term-A} deleted" shows and the row is gone.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-N3: “Inactive terms and Credit Hold are valid sources (Move Customers is how a shop empties a deactivated term). Inactive terms are never offered in "Move To".”
  • S4-E4: “Moving customers off a deactivated term empties it; once no customer, vendor or invoice holds a term the shop created, it can be deleted.”
